entries.title: Logan Lobs Geo Off His Throne (Then Beats Himself Up About It)
entries.subtitle: A night of self-cannibalism in Group F, a one-man civil war in Group E, and Pete's Yanks bottling it like only Pete's teams can
entries.html:
Lo, dear watcher, the final round of group fixtures descended like a plague of biblical proportions, and by the time the dust settled over the away ends of three continents, the man who walked in as emperor of this whole sorry circus walked out clutching a silver medal and a grudge. For Geo, the throne is no longer his alone — and the man who nicked it spent half the night punching himself in the face to do it.

Group E — Logan declares war on himself

First, the comedy. 🇪🇨 Ecuador 2-1 🇩🇪 Germany was a fixture only the truly cursed could conjure — Logan's plucky Ecuadorians slaying Logan's own Germans, a man arm-wrestling his own reflection and somehow winning AND losing the same shake. Germany still top the group on six, so Logan's left hand is delighted; Ecuador limp into a nervy third and the best-third lottery, biting their nails through the medical results. Meanwhile 🇨🇮 Ivory Coast strolled past Barney's 🇨🇼 Curaçao 2-0, Joe's Elephants qualifying second and — joy of joys — vaulting to the summit of League 4, dethroning Barney's Canada in the process. Curaçao, with nine conceded and one scored, depart looking like men who turned up to the wrong party and apologised for the cake.

Group F — the House of Joe eats itself alive

Here was farce of the highest order. Joe owned THREE of the four sides in Group F, which is the sweepstake equivalent of betting on every horse and still finding a way to fret. 🇯🇵 Japan 1-1 🇸🇪 Sweden saw Logan's Japan qualify second while Joe's Sweden slid into the third-place purgatory. Then 🇹🇳 Tunisia 1-3 🇳🇱 Netherlands — Joe versus Joe, his Dutch machine battering his own hapless Tunisians, who finish played three, lost three, twelve conceded, a campaign so grim it makes Pete's Haiti look like vintage Brazil. The Netherlands top the group on seven and sit proudly second in League 1. Joe banked a tidy SEVEN points on the night — the biggest haul going — even while feeding his own lambs to his own lions.

Group D — Pete's Yanks find a new way to break his heart

🇵🇾 Paraguay 0-0 🇦🇺 Australia was the goalless shrug that nudged Geo's Socceroos through in second and left Barney's Paraguay sweating on the lottery. And then the night's true gut-punch: 🇹🇷 Turkey 3-2 🇺🇸 United States. Sean's already-doomed Turks summoned a glorious, pointless victory — they're out regardless — purely, it seems, to wound Pete one last time. Pete's USA still top the group on six, mind, so the damage is cosmetic; but after the Haitian apocalypse, even a meaningless slap stings.

The Reckoning

And so to the ledger, where the earth has moved. Logan, +4 on the night, leapfrogs Geo to seize the £60 player league outright — except they're level on 36, separated by the thinnest of margins, an overtake so narrow Geo can feel Logan's breath on his neck. Joe's +7 was the night's fattest feast yet leaves him a stationary fourth on 27, level with Barney. Sean nicked three from his doomed Turks; Pete, gloriously, banked the square root of bugger all and remains rooted to the bottom on 16. On the night: Joe gorged. In the tables: Logan is king — for now, and only just.

entries.title: Geo Conquers, Qatar Crumbles, and Pete Plumbs the Haitian Depths
entries.subtitle: A night the Thomas TwoShell empire ate itself in Group A — and still came out smelling of roses
entries.html:
Lo, on the Night of Wednesday 24 June the heavens opened and rained nine sweepstake points upon the chosen, while the wretched were left to gnash their teeth in the away end — and nobody, but nobody, gnashed harder than Pete.

Group B — Switzerland take it, Geo eats himself again

🇨🇭 Switzerland did exactly what Switzerland do, settling 🇨🇦 Canada 2-1 with the cold efficiency of a numbered bank account, topping the group on seven and handing Geo a tidy haul. Spare a thought, then, for Barney, whose Canada still squeak through in second yet contributed the grand sum of sod all to his evening. Meanwhile 🇧🇦 Bosnia-Herzegovina battered 🇶🇦 Qatar 3-1 — Logan's underdogs feasting on Geo's other lamb. Qatar, with two goals for and TEN against, depart the tournament looking like they wandered into the wrong stadium and apologised the whole way through.

Group C — Brazil purr, Scotland perish, Pete's Haitian horror

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Scotland were taken behind the bike sheds by 🇧🇷 Brazil, 0-3, and Sean's Tartan Army now sit third, biting their nails through the best-third lottery like a man waiting on a hospital scan. Brazil cruise. And in the night's true bloodbath, 🇲🇦 Morocco put four past 🇭🇹 Haiti, Logan banking yet more while Pete's Haiti slunk off with played three, lost three, nil points — a campaign of such unrelenting calamity it deserves its own Netflix documentary and a grief counsellor.

Group A — the house of Thomas TwoShell devours its own

Here, dear watcher, was farce of the highest order. 🇲🇽 Mexico dismantled Logan's 🇨🇿 Czechia 0-3 to finish a flawless nine points, knocking Germany off the summit of League 1 in the process. Then came the fixture for the philosophers: 🇿🇦 South Africa 1-0 🇰🇷 South Korea — Geo versus Geo, a man arm-wrestling himself in the mirror and somehow losing one hand. South Africa qualify second, South Korea wobble into third, and Geo simply shrugged, having owned every single boot on the pitch.

The Reckoning

And so to the ledger. Geo banked NINE points, vaulting from second to top of the £60 player league on 35, and now leads Leagues 1, 2 and 3 through Mexico and Switzerland — an emperor surveying his realm even as Qatar and South Korea bleed out at his feet. Logan matched him point for point, also +9, climbing third to second on 32 and crowning Bosnia atop League 7. The cruellest twist belongs to Barney, who walked in leading the whole thing and walked out third, undone not by his own teams but by the sheer relentlessness of the two men above him. Joe (a stationary fourth) and Sean (fifth) merely watched. And Pete? Pete props up the table on 16, the proud owner of the only side on the planet to lose all three, a man whose World Cup is now purely spectatorial. On the night: Geo and Logan feasted. In the tables: Geo is king. Long may he reign — until tomorrow, when football, as ever, comes for everybody.
